body:
Addressed after the fact check:
- Issue list now has #3359 for Circular.
- The "not used" sentence now names the 3D Pocket cases (Zigzag or Auto strategy, rest machining, Adaptive HSM strategy), as in `level_side.rs`.
- The PR body no longer says that the reply keeps `auto`: the reply leaves it out. The note about `docs/agents/mcp-tools.md` is changed.
- Not changed: the Trochoidal sentence. `EditOperationParams::new` calls `named_refusal` (`commands/operation/edit.rs:114`), and that calls `trochoidal_pass_start_refusal` (`types/sane.rs:87`). So the edit refuses by name too. The row now says "at the edit and again at `generate`".
Branch merged with main (plain merge).

<!-- pr-reviewer: ba2c824269ff48e62571df1feb40ab8e25a7b2c8 -->
**Review of head `ba2c82426`: clean.** A read-only Opus agent checked each statement of the row against `main`, and a scout settled the one point where the author and the checker did not agree.

- The key is on 2D Offset, 2D Pocket, 2D Adaptive, Circular, Bore, 3D Pocket and 3D Finish (`types/params.rs`), and Circular and Bore read it. The issue list is complete with #3359.
- `auto` is the default, is not written to the project file, and is not in the reply.
- The "not used" cases for 2D Pocket and for 3D Pocket (Zigzag or Auto strategy, rest machining, Adaptive) agree with `machining3d/level_side.rs`.
- 3D Finish reads the key only for Contour and Flat.
- **Trochoidal 2D Adaptive:** the row is correct as the author wrote it. `EditOperationParams::new` runs `named_refusal` (`commands/operation/edit.rs:114` → `sane.rs:87`), and MCP `edit_operation` builds the command with `new` (`mcp/edit.rs:324`). So the edit refuses, and generate refuses again (`generate.rs:902`). My third correction was wrong. No test goes through the MCP edit door for this case: follow-up filed.
- Face, Slot and Trochoidal Slot refuse the key by name; each other kind refuses it as an unknown field.
- The body has `Process change: yes`; `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` is not in the diff. `main` is an ancestor of the head.

The second row that #3569 asks for (`docs/agents/mcp-tools.md`) is not possible by hand: that file is generated, and the generic `edit_operation` door has no row for each kind there.

No build ran: the change is text in one skill file. The merge waits for the post-merge run of `main` at `4dba7019d` (a batch of four merges). The `PROCESS_VERSION` bump follows.

Merge note. Class: no refresh (head `ba2c82426` merged unchanged). Basis: the review with the marker on this head. Main is green through `f2b2369ed` (post-merge run), which ends the batch hold. The `PROCESS_VERSION` bump follows (with #2924).
